metadata.title: Apply Artifact Updates
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Apply approved changes from update-plan.md to artifact files (template, step, or process), executing each planned modification and verifying correctness. Use after plan-artifact-updates has produced an approved plan.

artifactPath.description: Path to the artifact (relative to project root)

output.description: Modified artifact files (JSON and MD) with verified changes

prerequisites: Memory contains: updatePlanRef (path to update-plan.md), artifactPath, artifactType from prior steps
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: load context → read plan → resolve files by type → read files → apply JSON → apply MD → conditional diagram update → verify (retry on failure) → update memory
Read update-plan.md and parse each change with its before/after state
Use artifactTypeConfig to resolve file paths and understand change targets per type
Apply changes sequentially: JSON first, then MD, then diagram if needed
After applying, verify EVERY change by re-reading the files
If any verification fails, loop back and retry the failed changes
Do NOT skip verification — this step's output feeds the review step

read: memory.json (previous step section: updatePlanRef, artifactPath, artifactType)
update-plan.md (in process folder, path from memory)
Artifact JSON file (current state before applying)
Artifact MD file (current state before applying)

tools: read_file - Read memory.json, update-plan.md, artifact files
search_replace - Apply changes that modify existing content
write - Apply changes that replace entire sections or create new content
bestPractices: Always read the current file state before applying changes — never apply blindly
Verify the current state matches the plan's 'before' description
Apply changes exactly as specified in the approved plan
If current state doesn't match 'before', log warning and adapt (artifact may have been partially updated)
Verify every change after applying — do not skip verification
If verification fails, retry the failed changes (loop back to apply)
Log progress for each change applied
Update diagram only when flow actually changes — avoid unnecessary modifications

substeps.name: Init-Step: Confirm Principles
substeps.description: Recall operating principles before starting this step
actions: Read `.processes/steps/_components/operating-principles.md` and recall all principles
Output: '✓ Principles confirmed for this step'

substeps.name: Load Context from Memory
substeps.description: Get required references from prior steps in memory
actions: Read memory.json to get: updatePlanRef (path to approved update-plan.md), artifactPath, artifactType, artifactName
Verify all required references are present
If missing, log error to log.json and stop

substeps.name: Read Update Plan
substeps.description: Parse the approved update plan into a list of changes
actions: Read the update-plan.md from the process folder using updatePlanRef
Parse the detailed changes section
Build a list of changes, each with: target file (JSON or MD), change description, before state, after state
Log: 'Found {count} changes to apply from update-plan.md'

substeps.name: Resolve and Read Artifact Files
substeps.description: Determine file paths by artifact type and read current state
actions: Based on artifactType, determine expected file paths using artifactTypeConfig
Read the artifact JSON file
Read the artifact MD file (if exists)
Verify current state matches the 'before' descriptions in the plan
If discrepancies found, log warning but continue (artifact may have been partially updated)

substeps.name: Apply Changes to JSON
substeps.description: Execute each JSON modification using type-specific change targets
actions: For each change targeting the JSON file:
Apply the modification using search/replace or structural edit
Log: 'Applied change: {description}'
Type-specific targets: templates (steps, params, metadata, refs), steps (substeps, guidance, deps, refs), processes (steps, state, params)

substeps.name: Apply Changes to MD
substeps.description: Execute each MD modification using type-specific change targets
actions: For each change targeting the MD file:
Apply the modification using search/replace
Log: 'Applied change: {description}'
Type-specific targets: templates (docs, step descriptions, param tables), steps (description, guidance, substeps), processes (checklist, state, params)

substeps.name: Update Diagram (Conditional)
substeps.description: Update mermaid diagram in MD if flow changed
actions: Check if any changes affect the artifact's flow (additions, removals, reordering of steps/substeps)
If flow changed: update the mermaid diagram in the MD file to reflect new sequence
If flow unchanged or artifact type has no diagram (process): skip
Log: 'Diagram updated' or 'No flow changes — diagram unchanged'

substeps.name: Verify Changes Applied
substeps.description: Re-read files and verify each change; retry on failure
actions: Re-read all modified artifact files
For each planned change, verify the 'after' state matches what was applied
Build verification results: pass/fail per change
If all verified: proceed to Update Memory
If any verification fails: log which changes failed, loop back to Substep 4 to re-apply only the failed changes
Log: 'Verification complete: {passed}/{total} changes verified'

substeps.name: Update Memory with Results
substeps.description: Record all results to memory for the review step
actions: Record:
changesApplied: list of changes with status (applied/verified)
filesModified: list of modified file paths
verificationResults: pass/fail summary
diagramUpdated: boolean
Log completion: 'Step complete — {count} changes applied to {count} files'

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Load context → Read plan → Resolve files by type → Read files → Apply JSON → Apply MD → Conditional diagram update → Verify (loop back to apply on failure) → Update memory

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Process parameters (artifactType, artifactPath) and previous step's plan (updatePlanRef from plan-artifact-updates)
fields: Information Produced: changesApplied, filesModified, verificationResults, diagramUpdated
Decisions Made: Diagram update decision, retry decisions on verification failure
